gotcha #7 (tu93): env.reset() is NOT idempotent -- it leaves a parity-toggling hidden state (same path, 6 reset+replays -> levels [1,2,1,2,1,2]). A reuse-one-env replay/deepcopy search detects parity-CONTINGENT wins that fail the fresh-env reproduction gate (gate correctly rejects -- no false claim). Fix: OfflineSolver branch_mode='fresh_env' (a brand-new env per candidate eval) so each evaluation sees the same pristine parity-0 the gate uses. Detect by replaying ONE path on N fresh envs vs 1 env reset N times: if levels differ, reset is non-idempotent.
